name: Geely Xingrui Intelligent Computing Center / Geely Changxing Data Center
notes: Located in Changxing, Huzhou; formally unveiled 2023-02-27 after going online in January 2023. Reported as Geely's largest internal cloud-data-AI computing platform; source reports compute scale rather than MW.

name: Wuxing District computing/data center projects
notes: Industry report lists two filed computing/data-center projects in Wuxing District, Huzhou, with total investments of RMB 785 million and RMB 395 million, focused on computing-cluster services and intelligent module upgrades; exact operators not provided.

name: China Mobile Yangtze River Delta (Jiashan) Intelligent Computing Center
notes: Signed in Jiashan County's Yaozhuang Town in 2024 with reported RMB 5 billion investment and 15,000P first-phase intelligent compute; People's Daily Zhejiang reported first-batch acceptance and delivery on 2026-06-30.

name: China Mobile Yangtze River Delta (Jinhua) Data Center
notes: Located in Jindong District/Jinyi New Area. Zhejiang source reports about 286 mu site, RMB 4 billion investment, 20,000 servers and 30T export bandwidth; 2026 report states 13,000 cabinets built and 86 MW IT load.

name: Lishui Big Data Cloud Center
developer: Lishui Cloud Data Center Co., Ltd.
notes: Major project in Lishui Economic and Technological Development Zone's Qibaiyang block; reported total investment RMB 1.5 billion, 313 mu land and 2019-2023 construction period. Later government document says Feilixin Lishui Big Data Cloud Center was completed and put into operation.

name: Jinshuitan water-cooled green data center
notes: Lishui government planning/status document states Jinshuitan water-cooled green data center and other big-data-center projects were being accelerated; no MW or operator detail found in brief search.

name: Ningbo Haishangxian Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Ningbo Haishangxian Information Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: Reported as a Fenghua District Development and Reform filing, project code 2511-330213-04-04-630391, at 211 Yuanfeng North Road, Yuelin Subdistrict. RMB 389 million investment; target 1,000P compute in two phases from 2026-02 to 2027-08.

name: Quzhou Four-Province-Border Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Zhongneng Digital Investment (Beijing) Technology Co., Ltd. / Huizhou Intelligence affiliate
notes: Investment agreement signed with Quzhou Smart Manufacturing New City Administrative Committee. Planned RMB 1 billion investment in three phases to provide data center, cloud computing and computing-platform services for Quzhou and surrounding provinces.

name: China Telecom Four-Province-Border Intelligent Computing Center
notes: Industry report says China Telecom's RMB 1 billion four-province-border intelligent computing center held a groundbreaking ceremony in Quzhou on 2025-07-31; details should be confirmed with local government or China Telecom releases.

name: Shaoxing Digital Science and Innovation Industrial Park Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Shaoxing Yuecheng Urban Development and Construction Group / Yuecheng Jishan Computing Power Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: Located in Gaobu Subdistrict, Yuecheng District. Reported RMB 1.89612 billion phase-one EPC/procurement project; intelligent-computing center building area 36,000 sq m on 25 mu, planned 7,000 cabinets and 30,000PFlops compute.

name: Shaoxing Jianshui Digital Intelligence Industrial Park and Computing Power Center
notes: Signed at Shaoxing investment attraction conference and landed in Yuecheng. Reported total investment RMB 12 billion, one-park-three-centers model, about 180,000 sq m total construction area and 7,000 cabinets.

name: Zhedongnan Intelligent Computing Center Phase I
notes: Located in Huangyan District, Taizhou. Zhejiang source says Phase I 400P compute is online, subscribed above nominal capacity and running at 80-85% utilization.

name: Zhedongnan Intelligent Computing Center Phase II
notes: Located at Huangyan Dream Innovation Park phase-II plot. Zhejiang source reports project has started, RMB 5 billion total investment and 4,000P planned compute; 2025 report says construction progress exceeded 80%.

name: Ruian Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Wenzhou Mingji Intelligent Computing Co., Ltd. / Ruian state-owned capital / China Telecom / Zhejiang Mingji Holdings
notes: Ruian, Wenzhou project discussed at 2024 Data Security Development Conference. Reported as a 2024 key science-and-innovation project; Phase I planned RMB 200 million for 256P compute, Phase II planned 25 mu data hall in Binhai New Area with at least 1,024P compute.

name: Putuo Offshore Green Intelligent Computing Island / World-Class Intelligent Computing Center Initiative
developer: Putuo District government / project partners not specified
notes: Putuo District is planning an offshore intelligent-computing island and world-class intelligent-computing center, emphasizing green marine-energy advantages and target average data-center PUE below 1.15. Specific project operator and MW not found.
